title: GET /changes behavior is untested
reasoning: The associated feed endpoint tests only cover listing feeds, creating a feed, and POST /sync. They do not exercise GET /changes at all, even though the route has distinct initial sync, incremental update, tombstone, ordering, and response cursor behavior.
recommendation: Add direct tests for GET /api/feeds/changes covering initial sync, incremental changes after a since timestamp, tombstones for deleted feeds, exclusion of deleted feeds from feeds, and response server_timestamp handling.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The current tests never request /api/feeds/changes or assert FeedChangesResponse fields.
suggestedRegressionTest: Create feeds with controlled updated_at/deleted_at values, call GET /api/feeds/changes with and without since, and assert feeds, tombstones, and server_timestamp semantics.
